releases.release_notes: OpenKE 1.0.0 Baseline Release with Semantic SWUpdate & GuppyScreen Integration
releases.changelog:
• Native SWUpdate dual-slot A/B streaming upgrade system
• GuppyScreen firmware update panel with USB auto-discovery
• OpenKE Power-Loss Recovery (PLR) dual-generation state machine
• PREEMPT_RT memory reclaim resilience (vm.min_free_kbytes=8192)
• Hung task recovery and flash dirty page pacing
